mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpClTranBuyerChoicePopListBackUp*/ SELECT X.BUYER AS BUYER, DECODE (SUBSTR (X.BUYER, 7, 1), 'G', (SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = X.BUYER), (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, X.CNT AS CNT FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER AS BUYER, COUNT (*) AS CNT FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.AGENT = #{com_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'T') AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY A.BUYER) X
